description_en: Queries the list of elastic network interfaces (ENIs) associated with a VPC NAT gateway when the VPC NAT gateway is referenced as an EPS resource by PrivateLink. This feature is currently not available
description_zh: VPC NAT网关作为服务资源对象被私网连接服务引用场景下，查询VPC NAT关联的弹性网卡列表，目前该特性暂不开放使用
name: DescribeNatGatewayAssociateNetworkInterfaces

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NAT gateway.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
NAT网关所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway to query
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the instance. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en:
The valid values of Filter Key:

ResourceId
Specify the ID of the EPS resource in Value.
NetworkInterfaceId
Specify the ID of the network interface controller (NIC) in Value.
ResourceOwnerId
Specify the UID of the user to whom the EPS resource ownership belongs in Value
fields.help_zh:
入参中的Filter Key的取值：

ResourceId
Value中需要填入需要查询的服务资源ID。
NetworkInterfaceId
Value中需要填入需要查询的弹性网卡ID。
ResourceOwnerId
Value中需要填入需要查询的服务资源归属的用户UID

fields.help_zh: Value支持传入多个值，逗号隔开

parameters.help_zh: 过滤信息，支持传入键值对查询结果进行过滤

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no subsequent query exists, leave this parameter empty.

If a subsequent query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。

如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 值

The pagination token. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query exists.

If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
